events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, born Farrokh Bulsara, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Freddie's 80th
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of a true rock icon. Imagine the party Freddie Mercury would be throwing today!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie's 75th
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring generations. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Our Kid's 54th
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite lyric from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released (UK single)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine 1975
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message, still resonating today.

events.title: First iPod released (2001)
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod's Birthday
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod dropped on this day in 2001. A game-changer for music lovers everywhere.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's 86th
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music continues to inspire peace and love.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, of Monty Python and Fawlty Towers fame, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's 87th
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel mayhem, his comedic genius is unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A truly diverse and influential record.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the music world lost an irreplaceable talent. Remembering the incredible life and legacy of Freddie Mercury.

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965 in the UK.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, showcasing their evolving sound.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost a voice for peace. Remembering John Lennon and his enduring musical legacy.
